data.text:
BAHA SA MAYNILA

The Manila PIO reported gutter-deep flooding in several areas, including Taft Avenue, Pedro Gil, PCU, and Nakpil Street, while flooding in front of Ospital ng Maynila has reached half-tire level as of Friday, August 22.

Motorists are advised to stay cautious and avoid affected areas.

📸 Manila PIO
